simple.meaning: נֵזֶק (nêzeq) is a Hebrew word meaning “loss.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: This word has limited occurrence data, so BibleIQ begins with the Hebrew word, its basic meaning, and the verse where it appears.

definitions.full: H5143. nezeq [ נֶ֫זֶק ] noun [masculine] injury, damage (Aramaic loan-word see Biblical Aramaic); — only construct הַמֶּלֶךְ כְּנֶזֶק Est 7:4 at the price of injury to the king.
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root meaning to injure ;

occurrences.englishText: For we are sold, I and my people, to be destroyed, to be slain, and to perish. But if we had been sold for male and female slaves, I would have held my peace, although the adversary could not have compensated for the king’s loss.”
